text: **Hint 1:** Consider the properties of mean-centered data. When you mean-center the data, the intercept term in the linear regression model becomes zero because the mean of the residuals is zero.\n\n**Hint 2:** Think about the implications of having full column rank in both $\mathbb{X}$ and $\dot{\mathbb{X}}$. This means that the columns of these matrices are linearly independent, which affects the uniqueness of the solution for the regression coefficients.
